In Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse, Pavitr is already a member of Miguel's Spider Society: Jessica Drew calls him in to help Gwen against the Spot in Mumbattan. Marvel Database lists Spider Society as his affiliation.

X-Men: The Animated Series episode 73 (season 5 ep 11, 'Old Soldiers'): in World War II, Sgt. Fury is a soldier in the Howling Commandos, not S.H.I.E.L.D. He is Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. from Spider-Man (1994) episode 13 on.

Spider-Man Unlimited episodes 1-2 ('Worlds Apart'): on Counter-Earth, Spider-Man decides to join John Jameson and the Resistance against the High Evolutionary (the Human Revolution). Marvel Database lists Human Rebels as an affiliation. Where it goes relative to the Daily Byte stage is not certain.

The Spider-Men were a one-off team the Beyonder and Madame Web formed against Spider-Carnage. It ends when Spider-Carnage is destroyed in Spider-Man (1994) episode 65 (Spider Wars Ch. 2), and Peter goes back to his Bugle life. Marvel Database: team Defunct; Peter's affiliation is Daily Bugle, Spider-Men (leader) listed as former.

The Spider-Men team he joins in Spider-Man (1994) episode 64 ends with the Spider Wars two-parter (episodes 64-65), when Spider-Carnage is destroyed. Marvel Database marks the team Defunct and lists Spider-Men only as a former affiliation for Octo-Spidey (Earth-11983).
